Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L02_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.04

Which revision is clearest for a speech audience?

answer.text: A. Use vague words that do not name the idea

feedback.text: This choice is incomplete because it does not improve the speech draft in a clear, audience-focused way.

answer.text: B. Put sentences together with no connection

feedback.text: This choice may sound related, but it does not fully address revision, clarity, cohesion, or standard speech communication.

answer.text: C. Timed rehearsal helps speakers adjust each section before presenting

feedback.text: Correct. This choice improves the speech by using feedback, clarity, cohesion, or standard English to support audience understanding.

answer.text: D. Add transitions without explaining the relationship

feedback.text: This choice weakens communication because it ignores how the audience will understand the speech.
